# Erdos.p184 — Erdős problem 184

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/184
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/184.lean`, theorem `erdos_184`, AMS 5).

Any graph on $n$ vertices can be decomposed into $O(n)$ many edge-disjoint cycles and edges.

## Statement
∃ f : ℕ → ℝ,
      (f =O[atTop] fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
      ∃ (D : Finset G.Subgraph),
        (∀ H ∈ D, IsCycleOrEdge H.coe) ∧
        IsDecomposition G D ∧
        (D.card : ℝ) ≤ f (Fintype.card V)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
